card.name: Inside the word coadminister
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the pieces of coadminister, coadministered or coadministration (co, admin, min, ister), mostly the middle pieces. It appears in drug-interaction sections.

modes.label: Co- before administered
modes.description: The 'co' piece when it comes before a hyphen and administered.
